text: Rugged Lark (May 1, 1981 – October 26, 2004) was a Quarter Horse stallion who achieved two American Quarter Horse Association (AQHA) World Show Superhorse titles in 1985 and 1987, and was also recognized as a three-time AQHA World Champion. He won the Silver Spur Award. Rugged Lark was the son of the Thoroughbred stallion Really Rugged and the Quarter Horse mare Alisa Lark, who was a great-granddaughter of Leo and a great-great-granddaughter of both King P-234 and Joe Hancock P-455. He earned AQHA points in Hunter Under Saddle, Western Pleasure, Trail, Hunter Hack, Reining, Working Hunter, Western Riding, Pleasure Driving, and Barrel Racing. In 1985, he was crowned World Champion Pleasure Driving Horse and in 1987, he became World Champion Senior Hunter Under Saddle Horse. Among his offspring are The Lark Ascending, Rugged Painted Lark, Look Whos Larkin (1999 AQHA World Show Superhorse), Jolena Lark, Rugged Lark II, and Forever a Lark. He is one of only two stallions to sire offspring that also won Superhorse titles. Rugged Lark was euthanized in October 2004 due to colic and was inducted into the AQHA Hall of Fame.
